title: Place a DIFFPAIR parameter set directive
summary: Creates a parameter set with a hidden DifferentialPair parameter through SchObjectFactory and adds it to the active sheet with the PreProcess/PostProcess bracket and SCHMPrimitiveRegistration; also lists the sheet's parameter sets.
phrasings: mark a net as a differential pair on a schematic
add a parameter set to a schematic sheet
create schematic objects with the object factory

commands.name: PlaceDiffPairDirective
commands.description: Place a DIFFPAIR parameter set on the current sheet
commands.params: X=<mil>|Y=<mil>|Name=<set name>|Value=<text> (defaults X=2400, Y=4000, Name=DIFFPAIR, Value=TRUE)

commands.name: ListParameterSets
commands.description: List the parameter sets on the current sheet
